baseline_models.focus_anchor: The witness-against construction coordinates the possessed tongue, hands, and feet and directs their evidence toward the owners' prior work.
baseline_models.mechanism: Knowledge-bearing testimony is distributed across speech, manual agency, and locomotion. The body is therefore not one substitute speaker but a set of differently situated evidence channels whose reports converge on intentional action.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge-based declaration supplies the forensic act coordinating the bodily channels.
The speech organ supplies the verbal channel of the distributed record.
The convention of assigning deeds to the hands makes manual agency an evidence-bearing channel.
Walking on feet supplies movement and route as a distinct evidentiary channel.
Intentional action defines the object about which all three channels testify.

changed_reading.before: Body parts replace an ordinary witness and miraculously speak.
changed_reading.after: Speech, agency, and movement form a distributed embodied record whose independent channels converge against the actor.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The organs remain grammatically theirs, yet the testimony is explicitly directed against them.
baseline_models.mechanism: Faculties normally possessed for argument, control, force, and support are not merely removed; their direction reverses. Ownership persists while evidentiary allegiance does not, turning the actor's means of self-command into adverse witnesses.

activation_trace.role: The branch that identifies the tongue itself as witness makes the reversal internal rather than externally imposed.
Eloquence and argumentative capacity mark the tongue as the usual channel of self-defense now turned adverse.
Possession and control literalize the owners' prior command over the hand that now resists that command.
The alternate mapped branch contributes supported strength, activating the loss of bodily support at the evidentiary moment.

changed_reading.before: The owners lose control of their organs for a moment.
changed_reading.after: Their own controlled, force-bearing, and defensive faculties retain bodily ownership while reversing allegiance and testifying adversely.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Hands and feet are named immediately before the clause about what the owners used to work.
baseline_models.mechanism: The work root itself contains images of working limbs, manual laborers, and travelers on foot. The closing verb therefore loops back over the enumerated organs: the instruments that executed the work audit their own deployment.

activation_trace.role: The branch explicitly names active bodily members, making the work lexeme redescribe the witnessing organs.
Manual workers connect work to hands as the instruments that materially execute it.
Travelers walking on their feet connect work to locomotion and the routes by which action is carried out.
Craft skill locates competent execution in the hand rather than in abstract intention alone.
Pedestrian movement locates execution in the feet and completes the hand-foot division of work.

changed_reading.before: The limbs comment afterward on deeds external to themselves.
changed_reading.after: The working members are both executors and auditors, reporting how they themselves were put to work.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A marked day is set against the owners' prior, durative pattern of working.
baseline_models.mechanism: A span of past intentional activity is made present at a severe event of disclosure. Testimony operates as temporal deposition: accumulated conduct is condensed into a day on which what occurred across time becomes co-present and observable.

activation_trace.role: A duration rather than only a calendar date supplies the receiving frame for accumulated conduct.
The day as a severe event gives the temporal frame the force of a decisive disclosure.
Occurrence and presence in time make prior conduct available as something that truly took place.
Intentional action supplies the repeated material deposited across that prior time.
Presence with observation converts past occurrence into present evidentiary attendance.

changed_reading.before: A single future scene reveals a list of isolated acts.
changed_reading.after: A decisive day condenses a prior duration of intentional conduct and makes its accumulated bodily history present.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier legal sequence makes accusation depend on knowledgeable witnesses and repeatedly exposes their absence or insufficiency. The focus then supplies an endogenous witness set: the actor cannot evade proof merely because no external observer can complete the case.

activation_trace.role: Verbal casting supplies the accusation whose proof requires a disciplined witness process.
Knowledge-based declaration supplies both the required witnesses and the legally consequential testimony.
Repeated declarations under an explicit lack of other witnesses expose the problem of evidence confined to the parties.
The renewed demand for witnesses makes failure of proof determine the status of the accusers' speech.
Deed-bearing hands help form the internal witness set that cannot be absent from the actor's own conduct.

structural_cues: 24:4 and 24:13 demand witnesses for an accusation, while 24:6 explicitly presents a case with no witnesses beyond the parties.
The focus introduces three possessed bodily classes as witnesses against their owners.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated witness deficit and then bodily testimony; I infer that the latter closes the former. A live alternative is that the focus invokes universal judgment without specifically answering the earlier legal problem.

changed_reading.before: The body is an extraordinary but generic source of testimony.
changed_reading.after: The body is the inescapable internal witness set that closes the evidentiary gap left by absent or failed external witnesses.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context stages a false report as a causal chain: distortion arrives, each participant acquires a share, tongues receive it, speech circulates it, the matter diffuses, and footsteps are followed. Bodily testimony can therefore replay not just a verdict but each actor's place in acquisition, transmission, and propagation.

activation_trace.role: A lie turned away from truth supplies the distorted object entering the social chain.
The image of acquiring organs makes each participant's bodily apparatus the means by which a share is taken on.
Receiving and taking up speech supplies the intake step of the transmission mechanism.
Language, report, and message make the tongue the relay channel rather than a passive observer.
Speech spreading among people supplies the outward relay from one participant to another.
Diffusion and circulation scale the relay into a social propagation process.
Followable steps leave a route through which the propagated action advances.
Working bodily members bind intake, relay, and movement back to the organs that later report their use.

structural_cues: 24:11 assigns each participant what was acquired; 24:15 describes tongue-mediated reception and speech without knowledge; 24:19 names diffusion; 24:21 repeats followed steps.
The focus names tongue, hands, and feet in the same order of communicative, operative, and locomotor capacities.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the stages but does not explicitly label them a chain of custody; I supply that causal sequencing and read the organs as retaining their segment. A live alternative is that the steps language is a general moral sequence rather than part of this report's spread.

changed_reading.before: The organs testify to an undifferentiated bad deed.
changed_reading.after: The organs replay a rumor's embodied supply chain, locating who took it up, relayed it, operationalized it, and carried it onward.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the immediate four-ayah sequence, verbal accusation points outward, bodily testimony turns against the accusers, the due account is paid in full and truth is made manifest, and the targets are separated from what was said. The accusation's vector rebounds through the accuser's own speech apparatus.

activation_trace.role: Verbal casting gives the accusation an outward vector toward protected targets.
The tongue-as-witness branch turns that same speech-bearing faculty inward against its owner.
Full completion without deficit supplies the settlement produced by the reversed evidence.
Accounting and recompense give the completed settlement its judicial function.
Establishing and manifesting truth supplies the result of the body's adverse testimony.
Separation and innocence move the targets away from the accusation once truth is established.
Circulating speech identifies the material from which the targets are declared separate.

structural_cues: 24:23 presents accusers and their targets; 24:24 places testimony against a plural group; 24:25 completes their due in manifest truth; 24:26 declares a group clear of what is said.
The focus stands exactly between outward accusation and the paired outcomes of settlement and exoneration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency and the adverse direction; I infer that the focus pronouns continue the accusers of 24:23 and that their own speech circuit clears the accused. The materially live alternative is a broader judgment scene whose pronouns are not limited to that local case.

changed_reading.before: Bodily testimony is a general confession of unspecified wrongdoing.
changed_reading.after: In the local sequence, the accusing faculty turns on its owner, reverses the allegation's direction, and enables both full settlement and exoneration.

context_deltas.mechanism: The privacy sequence already makes a foot produce knowledge without words: impact externalizes something intended to remain concealed. The focus can thus be read as multimodal testimony in which feet reveal through the consequences of movement, not only by acquiring a miraculous voice.

activation_trace.role: Appearance and emergence establish the visible pole of the context's hidden-manifest contrast.
Concealment establishes the private state that conduct may nevertheless expose.
Repeated physical impact includes the foot-strike whose material effect carries information outward.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the evidentiary result generated by the movement.
Concealment supplies the hidden content made knowable through the foot's effect.
The literal foot anchors the earlier nonverbal disclosure directly in the focus witness list.
A sign that indicates a condition permits testimony to include bodily traces rather than speech alone.

structural_cues: 24:29 places manifestation and concealment side by side.
24:31 explicitly links a foot impact to hidden adornment becoming known.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies foot impact, concealment, and resulting knowledge; I infer that this is a local model for nonverbal bodily testimony. A live alternative is that the focus intends literal vocal testimony while 24:31 is only a behavioral regulation.

changed_reading.before: Feet must be imagined as mouths that verbally report.
changed_reading.after: Feet already testify semiotically: movement produces traces and effects that disclose what the actor meant to keep hidden.

context_deltas.mechanism: The light-darkness sequence separates apparent work from actual account and depicts a hand brought out yet barely visible to its owner. At the focus, that same kind of hand becomes a source of legibility, so embodied evidence overcomes both deceptive appearance and failed self-perception.

activation_trace.role: Intentional works supply the conduct whose appearance and final account diverge.
A water-like shimmer supplies deceptive visibility: something seems present but will not bear inspection.
Full settlement without loss replaces deceptive appearance with exact accounting.
Bringing something out of concealment frames the hand as an attempted object of disclosure.
The literal hand is present but not reliably available to its owner's sight.
Ordinary visual perception supplies the failed route by which the owner tries to know the hand.
Illumination supplies the condition under which what darkness hid can become legible.
The deed-bearing hand converts restored legibility into evidence about action rather than anatomy alone.

structural_cues: 24:39 compares works to a mirage and immediately replaces their apparent value with a fully settled account.
24:40 depicts layered darkness in which a person brings out a hand but can scarcely see it, then makes light the condition of visibility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deceptive appearance, exact account, an unseen hand, and light; I supply the arrow from optical visibility to forensic legibility. A live alternative is that the hand scene illustrates guidance only and does not explain bodily testimony.

changed_reading.before: The hand reports facts already transparent to its owner.
changed_reading.after: The hand makes conduct legible precisely where self-perception and outward appearance had failed, replacing mirage with accountable evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later context contrasts verbal profession and strenuous oath with enacted, recognizable obedience. Tongue testimony at the focus is therefore not simply one more statement: it is cross-checked against hands and feet, while performed work tests whether speech and action agree.

activation_trace.role: A statement that may assert what is not realized supplies the potentially unreliable profession.
Compliance supplies the action claimed by the speakers.
Turning away supplies the bodily reversal that falsifies the prior verbal profession.
The apportioned oath supplies intensified speech that is explicitly refused as sufficient proof.
Actual compliance replaces oath as the relevant criterion.
Recognition by an identifying trace makes obedience something knowable from effects.
Knowledge of the inner reality of a matter defeats reliance on polished verbal claims.
Intentional action supplies the performance against which profession and oath are checked.
The eloquent tongue anchors the claim-making channel that no longer controls the evidentiary account.

structural_cues: 24:47 places a profession of belief and obedience immediately before enacted turning away.
24:53 rejects strenuous oaths, names recognizable obedience, and closes with knowledge of what the speakers do.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit speech-performance mismatches; I infer that the focus's several organs function as mutual cross-checks. A live alternative is that these later verses exhort obedience without specifying the mechanism of the earlier bodily testimony.

changed_reading.before: All organs merely repeat a single compelled confession.
changed_reading.after: The tongue's profession is one contested channel, while hands and feet supply the performance record that tests whether words and action agree.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's closing verse repeats the focus's day-and-work frame but adds return and notification. Bodily testimony is thus not only evidence delivered about actors; it is the mechanism by which their accumulated work returns to them as inescapable news.

activation_trace.role: A temporal span repeats the focus's marked day and closes the surah's accountability frame.
Return to a prior point supplies the movement by which actors are brought back to the source of judgment.
Delivered news supplies the reflexive disclosure through which actors learn their own record.
Intentional work exactly repeats the focus's evidentiary object.
Knowledge-bearing declaration provides the embodied medium for the final notification.

structural_cues: 24:64 repeats both the marked day and what the actors did, while adding that they are returned and informed.
This closing echo brackets the focus within a whole-surah movement from hidden conduct to disclosed account.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the lexical echo and return-notification sequence; I infer that bodily testimony is one mechanism of that notification. A live alternative is that the closing notification summarizes judgment without identifying how the information is conveyed.

changed_reading.before: The body reports the actor's deeds outward to a court.
changed_reading.after: The embodied record returns the actor's own history as news to the actor, closing a temporal loop of action, return, and recognition.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the speech sense of the same root whose surface denotes feet, not the surface's ordinary meaning. It remains anchored in the explicit feet-plus-testimony construction and is useful as a resonance of unrehearsed evidence; downstream prose should label it a lexical echo, not translate the feet as 'improvised speech.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The feet are explicit grammatical subjects of testimony.

activation_trace.role: Unprepared, extemporaneous speech gives the foot-root an unscripted verbal resonance.
Knowledge-based declaration supplies the actual testimonial construction that contains the resonance.

changed_reading.before: The feet deliver a prepared verbal deposition like ordinary witnesses.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory root echo, their evidence is unprepared and unrehearsed, outside the owner's managed defense.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapped root for the hand spelling. It remains valid as split-root activation anchored to the exact focus occurrence and sharpens the adverse-direction construction; downstream prose should present it as an alternate-root resonance, not as the lexical definition of hands here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The hands belong to the owners but testify against them.

activation_trace.role: Supported strength turns the hand into the owner's usual reinforcement before that reinforcement changes sides.
A protective barrier supplies the defensive function that bodily evidence now penetrates or reverses.
Knowledge-bearing testimony redirects strength and protection toward proof against the owner.

changed_reading.before: Hands are only anatomical instruments made to speak.
changed_reading.after: In the alternate-root resonance, the owner's strength and protection cease supporting denial and instead reinforce the adverse evidence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain because it activates the work root's image of a well-trodden road. It remains tightly anchored by the focus's work clause and feet, and it explains how repeated action can leave a traversable trace; downstream prose should render it as a path analogy rather than claim that the verse lexically says 'road.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Feet testify concerning what the owners repeatedly worked.

activation_trace.role: A well-trodden working path materializes repeated conduct as a route worn by passage.
Walking feet are the members that traverse and wear the route into a trace.
An indicating sign converts the worn route into evidence of where repeated action went.

changed_reading.before: Deeds are discrete items recalled one by one.
changed_reading.after: Repeated work wears a path into the body, and the feet testify by exposing the route habitually traversed.

strongest_changes: The earlier witness rules turn bodily testimony into an endogenous solution to failed or absent external proof.
The accusation sequence and rumor sequence make the tongue's testimony a reversal and replay of speech that had been cast, acquired, and circulated.
The foot-impact rule shows that bodily testimony can be nonverbal: movement itself makes concealed material knowable.
The later contrast between oath and recognizable obedience makes tongue, hands, and feet mutual checks on profession versus performance.
The closing return-and-notification echo turns testimony into the actor's own history returning as news.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet supplied unusually exact bodily mechanisms: tongues relay unsupported speech, acquiring organs take on a share, foot impact discloses what is hidden, an unseen hand sits inside a light-darkness account, and the final day repeats the focus's work clause. Together these cues changed a generic miracle of speaking limbs into a multimodal chain of custody, reversal, and self-notification.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the focus pronouns are tightly limited to the accusers of 24:23 or open into a universal judgment scene.
Whether the foot-sign and hand-visibility links are intended mechanisms or productive cross-domain analogies supplied by the reader.
How much weight downstream prose should give the non-dominant hand mapping and the remote speech/path branches without mistaking resonance for surface translation.
